PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Results-driven software engineer with strong foundation in distributed systems, high-concurrency backend services, and clean architecture. Experienced in designing fault-tolerant microservices, optimizing database throughput, and shipping production code with rigorous test coverage.
EDUCATION
B.Tech in Electronics and Communication Engineering — Birla Institute of Technology and Science (2022 - 2026)
Grade: CGPA 8.80/10.0
WORK EXPERIENCE
Software Development Engineer I — Razorpay Software Pvt. Ltd., Bengaluru, India | Jun 2025 - Present
• Migrated monolithic checkout ser­vice to gRPC microser­vices, shrinking cloud compute costs by 32% and reducing deployment cycle times from 4 hours to 12 minutes.
• Architected high-throughput payment webhook processor using Go and Redis Streams, handling 14,000 requests/sec with p99 latency under 28ms.
• Engineered distributed idempotency layer with Redis and PostgreSQL, eliminating 100% of double-debit anomalies during peak ﬂash sales.
PROJECTS
Autonomous Code Review Linter & Security Auditor [Python, AST, Tree-sitter, Docker, FastAPI]
• Engineered static analysis pipeline parsing abstract syntax trees (ASTs) to detect SQL injection, unvalidated deserialization, and memory leaks.
• Built automated GitHub Action integration running checks across 200+ pull requests with an average scan duration under 3.5 seconds.
• Containerized execution sandbox using gVisor and Docker to securely isolate untrusted student code submissions.
Distributed Log-Structured Key-Value Store [Go, Raft Consensus, gRPC, LSM-Tree, Docker]
• Implemented distributed LSM-tree storage engine in Go with write-ahead logging (WAL), SSTable compaction, and bloom filters.
• Embedded Raft consensus algorithm for distributed multi-node replication, surviving arbitrary node crashes without state divergence.
• Benchmarked performance using custom concurrent load generator, achieving 85,000 read operations/sec across a 5-node cluster.

Languages: Go, Java, Python, TypeScript, C++, SQL
Frameworks & Systems: Spring Boot, Node.js, FastAPI, React, Next.js, gRPC
Databases & Storage: PostgreSQL, Redis, MongoDB, Apache Kafka, Elasticsearch
Cloud & DevOps: Docker, Kubernetes, AWS (EC2, S3, RDS), Git, CI/CD Pipelines
